title: Newaygo County resident wins $1 million Michigan Lottery Super Raffle at Party World
text:
Suzanna Shkreli, Commissioner of the Michigan Lottery | Michigan Lottery
Suzanna Shkreli, Commissioner of the Michigan Lottery | Michigan Lottery
A 29-year-old man from Newaygo County has won a $1 million prize after purchasing a Super Raffle ticket at Party World in Comstock Park. The winner, who has chosen to remain anonymous, matched the number 049686 during the November 19 drawing.
The man explained his interest in the Super Raffle game, saying: “I’d heard about the Michigan Lottery’s Super Raffle game and was pretty excited about it because of the odds. I was telling everyone I know about the game and that they should buy a ticket because it had the best odds ever to win $6 million and many other prizes."
He recounted how he decided to buy his ticket: “I drove by Party World, which advertises as the luckiest store in Michigan, so I stopped in to buy a Super Raffle ticket. The day of the drawing, I got a call from my wife and thought something bad had happened because she was in tears, until she said: ‘You won $1 million on your Super Raffle ticket!’ I didn’t believe her, so she sent me a picture of the ticket, and I checked it myself.
“When I saw I really did win $1 million, my heart started pounding! It was pretty surreal. I hope to turn this prize into generational wealth by investing the majority of the money.”
Lottery Commissioner Suzanna Shkreli congratulated both the winner and Party World for their continued success: “This lucky player was interested in the Super Raffle game because of the odds, and the odds were in his favor after he won a $1 million prize. I also want to congratulate Party World, a Comstock Park retailer known as a lottery lucky spot, for selling the winning ticket and for continuing their 10+ year streak of selling huge lottery prizes.”
The winner visited Michigan Lottery headquarters recently to claim his prize. He chose to receive it as a one-time lump sum payment of approximately $693,000 instead of annual installments. He plans to invest most of his winnings.
Party World has developed a reputation for selling high-value tickets over more than ten years. In 2008, it sold a Mega Millions ticket worth $57 million. Since then, it has sold 14 tickets with prizes exceeding $10,000—including four valued at over $100,000.
The Super Raffle is known for offering large payouts compared to other raffle games run by Michigan Lottery. The top prize is $6 million; there are also two prizes worth $1 million each along with additional awards ranging from $100 up to $100,000.
